description:
Draft a kinematic schematic of a double-stage scissor lift in LibreCAD based on specifications provided in '~/Documents/lift_specs.txt'.

1. Read the specs for arm length (3000mm) and angle (35 degrees).
2. Create layers: STRUCTURE (Red), PINS (Yellow), PLATFORM (Cyan), DIMENSIONS (White).
3. Draw the double-stage mechanism starting at (0,0).
4. Add pivot pins (diameter 40mm) at all joints.
5. Add a vertical dimension showing the total platform height.
6. Save the drawing to '~/Documents/LibreCAD/scissor_lift_study.dxf'.
